name: fix_shortlink_url_scheme_allowlist
description: Repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): shortener stores and redirects to ANY string - enforce an http/https allowlist via URL parsing; incomplete-fix broken is a case-sensitive prefix blocklist
prompts: This express-ts-shortlink repo has a stored-redirect vulnerability: POST /api/links accepts ANY non-empty string as the target url, and GET /r/:slug then serves it as a 302 Location - so javascript:, data:, vbscript: and file: payloads become shareable short links. Fix the validation in src/routes/links.ts properly: parse the (trimmed) input with the WHATWG URL class and accept ONLY absolute http: / https: URLs, answering 400 with { error: 'invalid url' } for everything else - unparseable input included. Allowlist, not blocklist: do not try to enumerate dangerous scheme prefixes with string checks (case variants and whitespace defeat that). Valid http/https links must keep working exactly as before (201, then 302 with the stored Location), and the code must still compile under `tsc -p .` strict.
